explanation: Accumulate shifted copies of y for set bits of x. The helper uses XOR for sum bits and shifted AND for carries, avoiding arithmetic addition and multiplication; BigInt preserves exact long results.
timeComplexity: O(w²) big-integer bitwise-operation steps as a conservative bound for shifted multiplication plus carry propagation; each BigInt operation also has a width-dependent bit cost.
spaceComplexity: O(w) bits for a constant number of BigInt values, where w bounds operand and intermediate widths. Each carry step performs operations on those bits.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
correctness: At each outer iteration, the accumulated product plus the unprocessed multiplicand times the shifted multiplier equals the original product. A set low bit contributes the shifted multiplier, after which shifting advances to the next bit. The Add helper preserves a+b because XOR holds carry-free sums and shifted AND holds pending carries; no arithmetic addition or multiplication is needed.
walkthrough: For x=13 (binary 1101) and y=6, the set bits select 6,24 and 48. The carry-propagating helper combines those contributions into 78. The shifted contribution 12 is skipped because bit 1 of x is zero.
edgeCases: Long results are assembled without converting bits to strings.
Input/result values must satisfy the displayed long contract.
